entities.summary: Lenovo was a Chinese multinational technology company established in 1984 Headquartered in Beijing. Founded 1984. The company began as a subsidiary of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and was originally called Legend Computers. In 1988, it was renamed to Lenovo Group, and in 2009, it acquired IBM's PC division. This acquisition gave Lenovo a significant foothold in the global PC market, allowing it to expand its operations and increase its market share. The acquisition also enabled Lenovo to develop and manufacture its own line of ThinkPad laptops, which became highly popular among business users. Lenovo's success in the PC market was followed by its expansion into other areas, such as smartphones, tablets, and smart home devices. Today, Lenovo is one of the largest technology companies in the world, with a global presence and a diverse portfolio of products. The company's success can be attributed to its ability to adapt to changing market trends and its commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. Lenovo's legacy can be seen in its continued focus on developing cutting-edge technology and its dedication to providing high-quality products to its customers. The company's impact on the global technology industry has been significant, and it continues to play a major role in shaping the future of technology.
